text: This app is truly outstanding. Not only is it free, but it also offers a wide variety of beautifully designed, high-quality sections, with new ones being released every week. One of the things I appreciate most is the exceptional support from Marcus, the founder. He is always responsive, takes the time to answer all of my questions, and goes above and beyond to help me set up and customize sections. I genuinely love this app and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a well-designed, constantly improving app with excellent customer support!
Great app. The developer is extremely responsive and provides immediate solutions when you need.
grate app the sections are very good the customer support is 10/10 the best thing i liked about this app is they provide custom section within some hours my whole experience was excellent

Honestly didn't expect much from a free app, but it blew me away. The sections and conversion blocks look great, and support's been quick whenever I ask. You can even request custom sections if it doesn't have what you need. The bundling means I dropped the separate bundle app I was paying for.

I've tried to find an App with awesome and amazing sections for Shopify themes to no avail. UNTIL. Until I found Section Module: Theme Sections. I'm in awe how many sections and conversion blocks this app has. Other apps have a myriad of sections and conversion blocks too, but most of them are basic, generic, and not even worthy of looking at to be candid. Zero stars, copy-and-paste candidates. But Section Module: Theme Section has all the conversion blocks and sections that the big brands use. They also have the bundle and upsell app included as well other apps and services. And did I mention free right now? This is the best free app for Sections and Conversion Blocks on the Shopify App Store. In short, I can go on and on about this app. Install it on your store and see for yourself. Topnotch App, more than five stars!!!
Great variety of theme sections and really beautifully handcrafted, also the founder of this app is so supportive and friendly. Great customer support.
